conbody.p: While driving over a certain speed, Lane Keeping Assist detects lane markings (or road edges) and may warn you if your vehicle leaves the lane without using the turn signal and may assist with steering to prevent your vehicle departing from its travel lane.

section.title: Detecting sensor
section.p: Lane Keeping Assist uses the front view camera. Please refer to for the sensor locations.

note.p: For more details on the precautions of the front view camera, refer to .
